note: This file is the feature contract. Python (training) and TypeScript (inference)
must both read it and produce byte-identical vectors. A mismatch does not raise —
it silently degrades accuracy. Every value here is load-bearing; changing one
requires a new featureVersion and a regenerated golden fixture.

traps.variant: x86_32 only. x64_128 produces different numbers for the same input.
traps.seed: Pass the seed explicitly on both sides; never rely on a library default.
traps.signed: mmh3.hash() returns a SIGNED int32 in Python, and '%' on negatives differs between Python and JavaScript. Use mmh3.hash(s, seed, signed=False), or coerce with '>>> 0' in TS.
traps.encoding: Encode the string to UTF-8 bytes before hashing, on both sides.
forbidden: Python's built-in hash() — salted per process (PYTHONHASHSEED), not stable across runs.
sklearn HashingVectorizer — carries its own tokenization, normalization and signed-hashing trick that would have to be reproduced exactly in TypeScript.

namespaces.source: every path segment INCLUDING the file name, with the extension stripped; src/orders/order.service.ts yields src, orders, order, service. The file name is kept because suffix conventions like *.service.ts or *.controller.ts are among the strongest signals a TypeScript codebase offers.

the FULL callee expression including the receiver, e.g. this.orderFactory.create yields order, factory, create. A leading `this` receiver is dropped — it appears on nearly every method call and separates nothing.
return type name with generic wrappers unwrapped; Promise<Order> yields order

tokenization.rationale: Unsplit identifiers make every symbol its own bucket, so the model can only recognise names it has already seen. The namespace prefix matters just as much: name:validate and callee:validate point at different classes.

numeric.scaling: StandardScaler over the numeric block only; the hashed block stays 0/1. The scaler's mean_ and scale_ ship inside the model artifact — inference must apply the same transform.
numeric.orderIsContract: Consumers must read the vector in exactly this array order. A shifted order multiplies a value by another field's weight and nothing errors.

fields.name: inDegree
fields.description: how many symbols call this one

fields.name: entrypointDistance
fields.description: shortest hop count from any entrypoint; -1 when unreachable

fields.name: hasThrow
fields.description: 1 when the body contains a throw statement

fields.name: isBodyless
fields.description: 1 for declarations without a body (overloads, interface members)

fields.name: isMethod
fields.description: 1 when the symbol is a class member

fields.name: branchCount
fields.description: if / switch-case / catch clauses. Deliberately EXCLUDES && and || short-circuits — see logicalCount.

fields.name: logicalCount
fields.description: && and || operators, counted separately so branchCount stays a statement-level notion

ablationVariants.rationale: B is split because degree fields are graph-global and everything else is file-local. Measured together they cannot answer whether classification can stay file-incremental.
